title: H3 Clip Plan
description: A video described as an ordered list of MiniMax H3 clips. Mode 'music_video': the picture is generated against one song that is injected into every clip. Mode 'free': H3 generates picture and sound (dialogue, voices, ambience). Clip start times are NOT stored: they are derived from the clip lengths. Reference images, voices and picture size are chosen in the workflow, not in the plan. See PLAN_SPEC.md.

version.description: Use 3. Versions 1 and 2 are still read, always as music_video plans.

project.description: Short name used for the output folder: output/h3_clip_plan/<project>/.

mode.description: music_video: a song is injected and kept untouched. free: H3 generates the sound of every clip (no song).

refs.description: Reference name -> short description of what the user must supply: an image, a voice sample, or both. Images are chosen in 'H3 Plan - Reference' nodes and voices in 'H3 Plan - Voice' nodes carrying the same name.

width.description: Optional fallback picture size. Normally left out: the size is chosen in the workflow. Give both or neither.

height.description: Optional fallback picture size. Normally left out: the size is chosen in the workflow. Give both or neither.

context_frames.description: Frames shared between a clip and the end of the previous one. Keep 39. In free mode only 39, 90, 141, 192, 243 are allowed.

crossfade_frames.description: 0 = hard cut between clips. Up to context_frames = linear blend over that many frames at every seam.

seed.description: Base seed: clip i uses seed + i unless it has its own.

song.description: music_video only (forbidden in free mode). file is informational; duration_seconds lets a checker verify the plan fits.

name.description: Unique label, used in file names.

frames.description: Raw clip length at 24 fps. Must equal 17k + 5 (56, 73, 90, 107, 124, 141, 158, 175, 192, 209, 226, 243, ...). Includes the context_frames overlap for every clip except the first.

continue.description: true = same shot goes on: the clip starts from the last context_frames of the previous clip. false = new scene, generated from scratch. Must be false for clip 1.

refs.description: References used by the clip, images and voices alike. In the prompt write {picture:NAME} and {voice:NAME}; the node numbers them. music_video: at most 9. free: at most 12, of which at most 9 images and 3 voices are used.

prompt.description: Complete MiniMax H3 full-reference prompt with the six sections. Name references with {picture:NAME} and, on a line of its own, {voice:NAME}. Never write <Audio N>.

lyrics.description: Informational: words newly heard in this clip.

dialogue.description: free mode: the lines spoken in this clip, for the checker. The prompt holds what H3 actually says.

speaker.description: A name of the clip's refs.

audio_feather_ticks.description: free mode only: soft release, in 25 ms steps, at the end of the sound copied from the previous clip.
